A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ACSSM, with matching research objectives and experiments. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable, allowing additions and revisions to be distinguished from relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: Section 4 and Tables 1–3 report original ACSSM classification, regression, interpolation, extrapolation, and runtime results.

after.justification: Section 4 and Tables 1–3 retain the original ACSSM experimental results, including predictive performance and measured training runtimes.

M1.justification: The controlled locally linear SDE, amortized encoder/decoder, transformer masks, and training/inference flow are retained. New scan pseudocode elaborates v1 Appendix B. The corrected main-text ELBO matches v1 Appendix A.7, and shared-eigenbasis initialization already appears in v1 Appendix C.3.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Human Activity classification, Pendulum regression, and USHCN/Physionet interpolation and extrapolation. No dataset, population, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same comparator membership within each experiment, including S5 in Pendulum regression and the same eight sequence-modeling comparators. Newly discussed works in Appendix A are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and the implementation appendices retain the same preprocessing, splits, observation masks, evaluation metrics, model sizes, and training budgets. Table 4's hyperparameters are unchanged.

E4.justification: No ablation, sensitivity, robustness, or error-analysis study is added or removed. Figure 3 retains the same illustrative pendulum inputs and target trajectories.

E5.justification: Both versions state that results are averaged over five runs with different seeds and use the same ± reporting in Tables 1–3. No additional statistical estimation or significance-testing procedure is introduced.

E6.justification: All performance and runtime entries in Tables 1–3 are unchanged. Examples include Human Activity accuracy of 91.4 ± 0.4%, Pendulum MSE of 2.98 ± 0.30 in units of 10^-3, and USHCN/Physionet runtimes of 2.3/3.8 seconds per epoch.

T1.justification: Theorem 3.8 and its proof are substantially revised: v2 explicitly requires a common eigenbasis, replaces the moment formulas with cumulative interval-dependent expressions, and expands the derivation and transformation back to the original basis. V1's proof instead simplifies to a constant transition matrix before asserting extension. V2 also corrects the covariance-integral sign in Eq. 19, aligns Eq. 28 with the appendix, and changes the entropy-dropping step in Appendix B.7 to an inequality asserting a nonnegative constant.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims: multi-marginal Doob conditioning, SOC-based variational inference with a tight ELBO, efficient parallel latent inference, and strong irregular-time-series performance.

C2.justification: New Appendix A adds a specific explanation of the claimed efficiency advantage over Schirmer et al. (2022) and Ansari et al. (2023), attributing their parallelization limitations to numerical Gaussian-moment approximation. The existing experimental interpretations and limitations concerning linearization errors and long sequences are retained.

D1.justification: V2 adds an ACSSM code-repository link in the abstract and explicit parallel-scan pseudocode in Algorithms 1–2. These expand access and implementation documentation; the existing architecture descriptions, hyperparameters, preprocessing instructions, and hardware information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: New Appendix A substantially expands research positioning across probabilistic and deterministic SSMs, twisted SMC, Feynman–Kac models, continuous dynamics, and conditioned diffusions. It adds discussion and citations for works including S4, Mamba, SIXO, diffusion bridges, and SMC-based language generation, beyond v1's mainly inline comparisons.

P1.justification: V2 adds a background/related-work appendix and acknowledgments, renames the Amortization paragraph to Auxiliary Variable, and makes localized prose edits. Original appendices A–C become B–D, while the main section sequence and most existing exposition are retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds two boxed parallel-scan algorithms and renumbers the existing training/inference algorithms from 1–2 to 3–4. Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–4 retain their substantive displays, with changed float placement, text reflow, and conference headers.

improvement.justification: V2 improves consistency through the covariance-sign and main-text ELBO corrections, and makes Theorem 3.8's shared-eigenbasis requirement explicit. Expanded research context and the code link also improve usability. These gains are limited by remaining technical problems: new Algorithm 2 mixes indexing conventions, and Appendix B.7 does not justify nonnegative Gaussian entropy from fixed covariance alone. The revision therefore provides useful clarification without fully resolving mathematical and implementation-documentation issues.
